image_description: A Blue Monkey (Cercopithecus mitis), a type of guenon, is perched on a thick tree branch in front of a wire mesh fence. The monkey has dark grey/blue fur on its back and limbs, with a lighter grey/white chest and throat. Its face is dark with a distinctive pale brow band and light-colored eyes. A large tree trunk obscures the left side of the monkey's body.
